title.zh: 普遍实践权威的更强目标

claim.zh: 待建立：整体生成与实际生命的伦理意义如何给可回应位置以普遍实践理由，而非仅保存给定目标。
claim.en: Open: establish how whole generativity and actual living supply universally warranted practical reasons for responsive positions, beyond preserving a supplied objective.

hypotheses.zh: 独立获授权的更强目标；不得以局部给定规范或行为收敛替代。
hypotheses.en: An independently authorized stronger target; supplied local norms or behavioral convergence do not substitute for it.

correspondence.zh: 伦理根据、认识、动机、实际遵循分别说明；完整关系不能由任意开关谓词取代。
correspondence.en: Normative warrant, recognition, motivation and actual compliance require distinct accounts; arbitrary predicate toggles do not replace the fuller relations.

detail.zh: 显式公理路线是已有成果；两者的完成标准不同。
detail.en: The explicit-axiom route is an established result with a different completion standard.

detail.zh: 当前中心主张未证；这不撤销 G0/J 下已经完成的成果。
detail.en: The central target remains unproved; this does not revoke completed G0/J results.

limitations.zh: 当前中心主张未证；这不撤销 G0/J 下已经完成的成果。
limitations.en: The central target remains unproved; this does not revoke completed G0/J results.

validation_scope.zh: 登记开放目标与已述边界，不声称新增证明或已完成普遍根据。
validation_scope.en: Records an open target and its stated boundary, not a new proof or completed universal ground.

next_delta.zh: 明确推进尚缺的规范根据推论，并保留真正对手；不重开已有局部机制。
next_delta.en: Advance the missing normative inference against substantive rivals without reopening completed local mechanisms.

history.zh: 2026-10-08：迁移既有成果身份与范围；不新增定理，不移动原始资料。
history.en: 2026-10-08: migrated existing result identity and scope; no new theorem or relocated source.
